Palette: gallery

One set of tokens, every page

Every published page carries this block from tools/design_tokens.py and declares none of it itself. Change the palette there, run scripts/retheme.sh, and the whole library follows. This palette renders one scheme (dark); light and dark blocks carry the same values. Other palettes on file: fluent, signal.

How to retheme

1
Add or edit a palette in tools/design_tokens.py and point PALETTE at it. Keep every token name; the tests check contrast and that the ground is never warm paper.
2
Run scripts/retheme.sh. It stamps every page, rewrites this preview and the metrics contract, rebuilds the impact report and the library API's page hashes, then runs the audits and the token tests.
3
Open this page and a few real ones, then open a pull request to staging. Nothing else to edit: pages use the tokens and never declare them, and the stamper removes any copy a generator sneaks back in.
